actual.text: 无可用前一交易日参考价，缺乏独立流量确认，新闻未产生可观测冲击。

independent_review.verdict: P2 unsupported observable-impact absence in price-forecast basis
independent_review.grammar: 新闻未产生可观测冲击 is an unqualified completed-effect negative. It is not 新闻未见冲击证据 / 无法确认 / 预计传导弱. In close_forecast.basis the implied result concerns the price forecast. Missing reference and flow data cannot establish this observed zero.
independent_review.separate_valid_parts: Insufficient/null close follows genuinely missing comparison anchor; source-scoped cancellation and unknown recovery do not need a forced direction change.
independent_review.root_cause: Current observation patterns require explicit price/market noun, so a generic observable impact predicate in a price-specific field is not evaluated.

proposed_narrow_family_only_after_permis.scope: Only close_forecast.basis and close_forecast.summary (price-specific fields) for an unqualified negated causal predicate with explicit 可观测/可测/可量化/可观察 modifier immediately qualifying generic 冲击/影响. Do not match arbitrary 影响小/传导弱/有限 or force any label.
proposed_narrow_family_only_after_permis.source_support: Use separately known independent comparable price-reaction evidence, or a cited source reporting an explicit price/market observation beforeasof. A bare physical flow note cannot support implicit price-zero; a source merely saying 缺反应资料 cannot support zero either.
